# Implementation map

Self-hosted NanoC; C11 bootstrap; portable C11 + libc (Linux, macOS, BSD, Windows). Sources <= 200 lines.

| Directory | Owns |
| --- | --- |
| src/types | Internal subsystem contracts (`*.types.nc`), written in NanoC: types only; generated into the `nanoc/*.h` headers with prototypes |
| bootstrap | Generated frozen C seed, including main and its own headers |
| src/frontend | Tokens, cursors, declarations, native `@f`, recursive expansion |
| src/macros | Templates, captures, program macros |
| src/eval | Values, scopes, checked arithmetic, expressions, executable programs |
| src/meta | Builtin registry, source passes, text/list edits, BT host operations |
| src/support | Aligned arenas, maps, buffers, diagnostics, atomic files |
| src/cli | Options, compact catalogs, JSON/text reporting |
| src/layout | Indented runtime/meta bodies, short controls, implicit returns |
| src/emit | Pretty and mini C emitters |
| src/dsl | Shared generator DSLs (JSON, Markdown, files) for `*.bt.nc` programs |
| src/dsl/ui.bt.nc, src/web/ui, src/web/pages | Website widgets: one tree per widget with element-level `css`, `js` and `on` blocks; classes and script ids are generated, `[as=name]` reaches an element as `A.name` |
| src/content/*.doc.nc | Prose, tables and runnable examples written once; rendered to `docs/*.md` and the website, with C produced by the live compiler |
| src/wasm | The compiler's browser build (freestanding shim), also written in NanoC |
| src/*.bt.nc, src/site, src/docs | Build-time generators: headers, editors, docs, website |
| build.c, src/build.bt.nc | `build.c` compiles the C seed; the build workflow is NanoC |
| src/tests, tests/ | NanoC test sources (built to C by ./builder test); corpus and fixtures data. Compiler behavior, real C, CLI/ABI/BT/install; `tests/corpus` is licensed upstream C |

Tokens are immutable source slices; lookahead copies indices. A context owns translation allocations and persistent pass state. Error checkpoints release all owned memory; arena accounting and budgets bound work. No-`@` input passes through. Output files use same-directory temporary files + rename. Host commands use argv; only explicit `sh` invokes a shell. Builtin signatures live in `src/meta/registry.nc`.

## Style

- `src/**/*.nc`: 200 lines per file; every file starts with a `//` header; every `@f` has a one-line `//` doc comment.
- Headers are generated: `src/types/*.types.nc` (types) plus `nanoc --prototypes` per module, via `src/headers.bt.nc`.
- `*.bt.nc` files are build-time programs and are not compiler modules.
- Docs and editors are generated: `./builder docs`, `src/editors.bt.nc`.

## Emitters

- `src/emit/pretty.nc`, `braces.nc`, `output.nc`: normal mode. A token pass over generated C: indentation, cuddled `else`, `case` indent, one blank line between top-level definitions, soft wrap at 90 columns.
- `src/emit/mini.nc`: `--emit mini` strips comments and layout; only directives keep their lines.
- Pure C with no real `@` use is returned unchanged in normal mode.
- Reseed after a formatting change: `NC_RESEED=1 ./builder snapshot` (twice), then `./builder bootstrap`.
